channel.title: Karamo
channel.desc: Erica says she witnessed her husband, James, cheating and she's heartbroken but desperate to save their marriage, but James insists he's not cheating and says unlocking his phone will clear his name; for nearly 35 years, Zach has been on a quest to find his son Anthony, and, after watching a previous episode of the "Karamo" show, he thinks he may have seen him; Zach's daughters, Tiffany and Zachia, are ready to welcome Anthony as the newest part of their family.
